text:
Maya (mktg): Quick plan: 48h paid surge for the July 12 webinar. Combine countdown creatives + search intent + a tight retarget window. Need budget sign-off and swap triggers by EOD.

Owen (growth): What's the budget and regions?

Maya (mktg): $1,000/day US + UK for 2 days ($2,000). KPI: CPL <$55, 40 registrations target first 24h.

Kai (creative): I'll make 48h/12h/last-hour banners + a short testimonial video for retarget. Want to A/B 2 CTAs: "Reserve spot" vs "Watch live".

Jules (analytics): Landing page split: 65% single-step form, 35% two-step. Add hidden field reg_uuid and GA4 event webinar_reg. Set alert: CPA > $70 -> notify @Owen.

Owen (growth): Bidding: max conversions with tCPA $50. Pacing: frontload 25% first 4 hours, but cap at 60% daily. Auto-swap creative if CTR <0.5% after 4 hours.

Maya (mktg): Retarget lists: 7-day visitors + 14-day video viewers. Retarget CTA variant should be testimonial-first.

Kai (creative): Uploading assets to drive now: https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/jul12_assets (placeholder).

ben-ads-bot: Draft created campaign_id=cmp_jul12_555, url=https://ads.internal/cmp_jul12_555

Maya (mktg): Ops checklist: UTMs, Zap to HubSpot, SFDC campaign tag "Jul12_Webinar". Who owns final go? @Owen

Owen (growth): I'll greenlight after QA. Posting monitoring rota.

Jules (analytics): I'll validate pixels and session stitch after upload.

Maya (mktg): Thanks team. If everything passes, go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. End thread.
